supersedes.why: the superseded snapshot drew display names from weekly_rosters raw vintage f7e970be65f97694, which covers weeks 1-2 only, while the reduced artifact actually in use was 0efeaede1505ab6e, which covers weeks 1-3. Two vintages of one family in a single snapshot.

I had also concluded from a TRUNCATED directory listing that recent captures retain no raw artifact, which was false -- capture-prod holds 15 raw weekly_rosters blobs including the matching one.
